title: Concept: TLS verification override configured (shell) — review required
description: In shell, curl -k https://x disables a TLS authenticity check. Without verification, encryption still runs but against whoever answers — including an attacker. The remedy is restoring verification (valid certificates).
applicability: shell TLS clients and configuration; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Machine-in-the-middle interception of all traffic on the connection; HIGH severity.
